method.value: The poster had Grok Bot search for unclaimed money for them and their wife across every state they had lived in, plus scan connected email and iCloud for evidence like old bills, tax returns, driver’s licenses, and a marriage certificate. Grok listed likely matches, the person confirmed which ones were theirs, then Grok assembled claim packets, converted them to PDFs, and submitted online after the users signed and returned photos of the forms.

outcome.value: The poster says it found about $1,000 across three states, including unpaid Burger King wages from the 1980s, and took under 10 minutes of their own time. In comments, another user said the same prompt found them almost $600, while a family-member search found $400.

notes.value: The main catch from the thread is to tell the agent every state and prior name to search, since claims can require address proof, SSN proof, and name-change documents.

source_text.body:
Search unclaimed property for family members
A commenter says Grok Bot's unclaimed-property search found money for their mom and uncle.
·
Nov 11, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The poster had Grok Bot search for unclaimed money for them and their wife across every state they had lived in, plus scan connected email and iCloud for evidence like old bills, tax returns, driver’s licenses, and a marriage certificate. Grok listed likely matches, the person confirmed which ones were theirs, then Grok assembled claim packets, converted them to PDFs, and submitted online after the users signed and returned photos of the forms.
How it went
The poster says it found about $1,000 across three states, including unpaid Burger King wages from the 1980s, and took under 10 minutes of their own time. In comments, another user said the same prompt found them almost $600, while a family-member search found $400.
Worth knowing
The main catch from the thread is to tell the agent every state and prior name to search, since claims can require address proof, SSN proof, and name-change documents.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Search unclaimed property databases, such as [state sites] and the national lookup, for [family member's full name], with past names [names] and past cities [cities]. Report each match with the amount, holder, and official claim link. I'm checking on behalf of family with their permission. Don't submit any claim or enter sensitive info; pause and show me before taking any such step.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xsx3q7/grokbot_just_paid_for_itself
